instruction: Put the cube in the green square and let go (either arm, any embodiment).

outcome.real_measurement: Cube centre inside the target square at every judged step: min(half - |dx|, half - |dy|) >= 0 (target frame axis-aligned). Real world: top camera, cube centre vs the marked square.
Resting on the table: lowest point of the cube within 5 mm of the table top at every judged step (a held or perched cube is higher). Real world: RGB-D cube pose vs the table plane.
Settled: cube speed <= 2 cm/s at every judged step. Real world: frame differencing of the tracked pose.
Stays put: cube centre moves <= 2 mm over the judged window. Real world: tracked pose, 1 s.

counterexamples.name: scripted_place
counterexamples.description: positive control: mplib pick-and-place, gripper/hand opened, arm retreats

counterexamples.name: hold_without_release
counterexamples.description: cube carried into the square and set down, gripper/hand stays closed on it

counterexamples.name: cage_no_contact
counterexamples.description: cube set down, gripper opened only ~1 mm beyond the cube width: no contact but still enclosed

source.protocol: v3: veritask/adapters/protocol_v3.py (frozen by E15), recorder veritask/adapters/maniskill_v3.TraceRecorderV3 with imsim signals (imsim/imsim/verify/smoke.py)
source.frozen: 2026-11-14, written before any E19 pick-and-place run; constants copied from place_cup_plate_v3 (settle, release margin) without tuning

notes: Embodiment-agnostic: robot_cube_impulse_Ns sums the substep-accumulated contact impulse between the cube and EVERY collision link of BOTH robots (arms, grippers, hands); cube_enclosure_clearance_m is computed from each embodiment's own finger geometry (registry): parallel grippers = sum of the two pads' clearances to the cube when part of the cube lies between the pads (inter-pad slab from the pads' collision vertices), hands = thumb clearance + nearest other finger clearance when the cube centre lies inside the convex hull of the hand's collision vertices; 1 m when not enclosed. The robot speed signal excludes gripper / hand joints (agent.gripper_joint_names). Hold A, quiescence and window exactly as in protocol v3.
